Object Storage

You might say

Where do user-uploaded profile pictures actually go?

A cloud storage service specialized in whole objects like images, videos, and files, accessed by link·For an article cover, the image bytes are stored as a file object while the database stores the article title, ownership, and related object key or URL. The page reads the article record and requests the image by address; access may be permission-controlled or time-limited, so a URL is not necessarily permanent or public.
Know first
Database
Object Storage
One cover image, two parts, stored separately
Upload complete · cover file objectcover-7.jpg · 248 KB
Object keycovers/7/cover-7.jpg
File bodyImage bytes in object storage

Object storage holds a complete file object under an object key. The article row in the database is separate data.

How object storage and the database divide the work

Whole files go to object storage: In this example, images, videos, and attachments are stored as objects; the article record keeps a related object key or address, while access depends on the project's permission setup.

Structured text goes to the database: In this example, the database record holds queryable article fields such as title, author, and status along with the related object key; the page then requests the cover according to the project's access setup.

Storage split in this example: This example keeps article fields that need queries in the database and stores the cover file as an object. Other architectures should be chosen based on query, transaction, and file-access needs.

What it does not do

In this example, the article record stores ownership, status, and the related object key for business queries; file access still follows the project's access-control path. Other architectures may organize this data differently.

For this article example, store the uploaded cover as an object and keep the title, ownership, status, and object key or address in the database record. Check the project's existing access-control design, then upload a cover and confirm it still displays after refresh.
